note: Readings and assumptions approved by the user. Only these, plus readings the contract text itself resolves, may produce a canonical priced result. Hand-maintained; never generated.

approvals.note: The rotary steerable must be recorded in the hole on the specific Standby day.
No global rank for documents omitted from Clause 2; each concrete conflict is resolved through its own switch.
For each hourly service and report day: the hours the report supports, less the one rig-up hour of Clause 21A, then the 6-hour minimum where it applies. Supersedes PER_BHA_RUN (see superseded).

Clause 36A's own words: a single adjustment on the first invoice submitted on or after the date of issue, and on no other. Chosen in the audit phase from the contract text; the alternatives ('after', per well, no repricing) stay in sensitivity and keep their LOW grade.
Phase 1 preferred reading A: Schedule 5 makes Parts B-E parts of the one signed Daily Drilling Report.
Phase 1 preferred reading A: 19A and Appendix G.

Consistent with the frozen civil works evidence policy: where the contract makes a record or signature a condition of payment and it is missing, the charge is not presently evidenced or payable; no other financial consequence is attached.

The invoice date is not proof of the submission date. Timing findings whose only basis is the invoice date are not raised; the invoice-date facts are kept as observations. No submission date is invented or inferred from billing.
Amendment No. 3's 416.00 governs DD-120 from its stated effective date (2026-02-01).

The missing call-offs mean well class and performance-section eligibility cannot be proven from the supplied contract evidence. The invoice is not evidence of its own entitlement. Any price that needs the class or the call-off stays unresolved (EVIDENCE_NOT_PROVIDED); unaffected services are priced canonically. The invoice-stated class is kept later only as the contractor's claimed class, marked unverified. The class sensitivity is preserved. PD-201 follows the same strict treatment: its rate is determinable without the call-off, but whether it was chargeable at all is not, so it is EVIDENCE_NOT_PROVIDED and its calculated amount is conditional only (never payable). The invoice's presence of PD-201 is not evidence that it was authorised.

approved_assumptions.text: The shifted Appendix G reading moves only the LWD rows and LH-714; the other surprising pairings stay literal.
HC-630 once per run counts only runs whose reports record a clean-out.
RM-510 metres are gated by RM-511's report word ('hole opener') as the underreamer; DD-111 by DD-110's word ('mud motor').
A well ran logging while drilling (LW-430) if any day had an LWD word in the hole.
A DD-120 hour quantity is kept on a Standby day only when hours were recorded.

rejected_assumptions.text: A well 'uses' the rotary steerable if any report on that well has it in the hole (dd121_condition reading B).
rejected_assumptions.instruction: Do not infer that the rotary steerable is in the hole on every report merely because the well used one somewhere else.
rejected_assumptions.consequence: dd121_condition reading B is no longer derived; DD-121 is evidenced only on Standby days whose own report records the rotary steerable in the hole.

superseded.reason: Clause 21A states that the report states the hours run and the invoice charges one fewer. Under PER_BHA_RUN, 3,897 DD-120 lines were billed exactly one hour below the report-supported quantity; under PER_DAY_THEN_MINIMUM no hourly line has that systematic difference. The task README says a reading that reprices invoices which otherwise reconcile exactly is probably wrong, and the PER_BHA_RUN approval was LOW confidence. A calibration correction supported by the contract text and a systematic reconciliation signal; no other reading was changed for its fit to billing.
